source.note: English wording checked against Sahih International at the cited source. Arabic must remain byte-for-byte identical to the approved Tanzil reference.

verses.english: Did We not expand for you, [O Muhammad], your breast?
And We removed from you your burden
Which had weighed upon your back
And raised high for you your repute.
For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship].
And to your Lord direct [your] longing.

audio.note: Do not render using the original long-pause concatenation. Supply and verify the exact user-approved shortened-pause audio asset before production.

readability_constraints.arabic: Large centered Arabic, each verse on its own line with separate ornamental number medallion; no text clipping or overlap.
readability_constraints.english: Each English translation paired directly beneath its corresponding Arabic verse; wrap by measured font width.
readability_constraints.collision_checks: Measure all text bounds; fail rendering if any text crosses panel boundaries, overlaps another verse, or collides with title/ornament.
readability_constraints.basmala: Display separately from verse text; never append it to verse 1.
